# meca-ojo-bosque (ORM, docs/MECANISMOS_ADULTO.md, family F2, Templo del Bosque), A: both ADULT at the entrance; eye switches: room 08's eye switch and room 02's gold eye, both room state.
# Run with --transport ws; switches below (#! switches). Needs daurosk branch orm/meca-adulto (the `key` test
# command) on orm/test8 (the `warp ... adult|child`, LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS). Generated by
# tools/harness/meca_adulto.py: change the table there, not this file. Positions from the Banc, not walked yet:
# a 'test place ...: failed' or a 'goto timed out' is the scenario's gap, not the code's.
# Mutant: the same run without LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS turns the 'never' lines of the adult list red.
#! noload
#! start coop: test warp done
#! saves 12-bosque
#! switches LICHII_COOP_PUPPET=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_FLAGS=1,LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS=shared_dungeon_adult.txt
#! timeout 221
#! expect B coop: puppet: P\d: create CoopPuppet_Adult
#! expect A coop: test flag ForestTemple_Room08_EyeSwitch_Clear \(0x2662855d\) = 1: queued within ojo..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0x2662855d \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within ojo..end
#! expect A coop: test flag ForestTemple_Room02_GoldEyeSwitch_On \(0x1e0ce831\) = 1: queued within ojo2..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0x1e0ce831 \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within ojo2..end
#! expect A coop: test flag ForestTemple_Level_Room_06_PressedEyeball \(0x24e06e44\) = 1: queued within ojo3..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0x24e06e44 \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within ojo3..end
mark start
warp ForestTemple ForestTemple adult
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark after
wait 600                # the other game lands too: puppets made
mark ojo
flag ForestTemple_Room08_EyeSwitch_Clear 1
wait 300
mark ojo2
flag ForestTemple_Room02_GoldEyeSwitch_On 1
wait 300
mark ojo3
flag ForestTemple_Level_Room_06_PressedEyeball 1
wait 300
wait 300
mark end
